lines.trans: Still alive with half a working body—you're just like a snake.
Vitality is my one strong suit. Around here there is still plenty of ripe fruit left to eat.
Before long I'll banish you from this garden too.
You're the real snake—whispering clever ideas to tempt him.

words.gram: Colloquial contraction of だろう after past tense た.
Plain imperative form of 入る (to enter).

lines.trans: Did Muranishi come to you?
Yeah, I accepted the present you sent my way and attached 250 million yen to it.
And then?
He ate it right up—the fruit of knowledge of good and evil.
I knew it would turn out that way.
Your little plan is coming along smoothly too.
No, no—we're still only halfway through.
Things are finally looking up. Let's have a celebratory drink at the office for the first time in ages.
